title: Integrative transcriptomic and machine learning analyses identify HDAC9 as a key regulator of mitochondrial dysfunction and senescence-associated inflammation in diabetic nephropathy.
summary: Machine learning selected five diabetic-nephropathy genes; external datasets, single-cell data and HDAC9 perturbation assays support a specific mechanistic candidate.
ai_technology: Integrated transcriptomics and learned feature selection are tested against external datasets and cell assays, including HDAC9 knockdown.

evidence.tested: Evidence supports an HDAC9-associated molecular result; no claim of patient-level causal effect or therapeutic benefit.
evidence.unknown: Primary Results describe the specific comparator, cohort or experimental check; limitations are stated narrowly.
evidence.ai_role: Integrated transcriptomics and learned feature selection are tested against external datasets and cell assays, including HDAC9 knockdown.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
